turns.question: What changed at work last week?
turns.transcript: I work as a designer at a small company. Last week I did a decision to change our website because customers couldn't find the prices.

corrections.wrong: Last week I did a decision to change our website because customers couldn't find the prices.
corrections.better: Last week I made a decision to change our website because customers couldn't find the prices.
corrections.explanation: По-английски говорят make a decision, а не do a decision.

turns.question: How did you prepare the design?
turns.transcript: We took a photo of the old page. Then I made a photo of the new design, and my manager gave me an advice about the colors.

corrections.wrong: Then I made a photo of the new design, and my manager gave me an advice about the colors.
corrections.better: Then I made a photo of the new design, and my manager gave me some advice about the colors.
corrections.explanation: Advice — неисчисляемое слово: говорим some advice, без артикля an.

turns.question: Who showed it to the team?
turns.transcript: I borrowed my laptop to a colleague so she could show the design at a meeting.

turns.question: What did she think?
turns.transcript: She was very interesting in the idea, but she said the menu is not clear enough. I suggested her to move the button.

corrections.wrong: I suggested her to move the button.
corrections.better: I suggested that she move the button.
corrections.explanation: После suggest не говорят suggested someone to do; используйте that she move.

corrections.wrong: She was very interesting in the idea, but she said the menu is not clear enough.
corrections.better: She was very interested in the idea, but she said the menu is not clear enough.
corrections.explanation: Здесь нужен человек, который заинтересован: interested, а не interesting — «вызывающий интерес».

turns.question: What happened on Friday?
turns.transcript: On Friday I lost the train to work, so I arrived late. I explained the problem to my team and they understood.

corrections.wrong: On Friday I lost the train to work, so I arrived late.
corrections.better: On Friday I missed the train to work, so I arrived late.
corrections.explanation: С поездом обычно говорят missed the train, а lost the train означает «потерял поезд».

turns.question: How did the launch go?
turns.transcript: I have been working on this project for six months. The launch went smoothly, and our first customers found what they needed.

turns.question: Would you change anything?
turns.transcript: I, I, uh, think the the new page is easier to use. We did a mistake with the first version, but we fixed it.

corrections.wrong: We did a mistake with the first version, but we fixed it.
corrections.better: We made a mistake with the first version, but we fixed it.
corrections.explanation: Здесь говорят made a mistake, а не did a mistake: это устойчивое сочетание.

turns.question: What comes next?
turns.transcript: If we get more feedback next month, we will improve the page again. I hope this helps customers choose the right plan.
